critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the 'Main deck window row' geometry by replacing the uniform dot array with two distinct rows of rectangular faces. Set the vertical offset between rows to 15% of the fuselage height, and vary the horizontal spacing (pitch) from a constant value to a variable interval that decreases by 20% as it approaches the nose and tail sections.

discrepancies.observed: A single continuous line of small dots along the fuselage side.
discrepancies.reference: Two distinct rows of windows (upper and lower decks) with specific spacing.

discrepancies.observed: A simple oval shape on the nose.
discrepancies.reference: A multi-pane, wrap-around cockpit window structure.

discrepancies.observed: No visible forward passenger doors or markings.
discrepancies.reference: Clearly defined forward cabin doors with distinct outlines.

discrepancies.observed: Uniformly spaced dots across the entire fuselage length.
discrepancies.reference: Variable spacing and grouping of windows, especially near the nose and tail.
